title: Bathroom Vocabulary Flashcards in Spanish — PreK & Kindergarten (Real Photos)

overview.description: Spanish vocabulary flashcards featuring bathroom-related words with real photographs (not illustrations). Uses real photos for concrete vocabulary acquisition. Part of a series — paired with House Vocabulary flashcards. Large file (60MB) suggests high-resolution photo cards.

gaps.name: real-photo-vocabulary-cards
gaps.description: Vocabulary cards using real photographs instead of illustrations. More concrete for young learners. Needs high-res images. Spanish bilingual format with word + photo.

notes: Part of Aless's Spanish language learning cluster (with Homeschool Languages, Los Pollitos, Spanish minibook). The use of real photos (not cartoon) is noteworthy — may indicate a preference for concrete/realistic visual style for vocabulary. 60MB file.
